applicant.name: Dr. med. Clara Moser
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Graz, Division of Nephrology

purpose: Research on kidney function in chronic kidney disease to improve care pathways between hospitals.
question: What is the mean eGFR of adults with chronic kidney disease, by hospital?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Use the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) per patient; patients without an eGFR are left out.
Report per hospital: adults with chronic kidney disease who have an eGFR value and their mean eGFR, one decimal.
